title: A cloud run's own triage command names the local run id, which holds no drafts
description:
For a cloud run (id run_…), every surface that spells the clearing command for the run's OWN untriaged findings — the close-out hold's triagePointer and the status model's WaitFinding attention — names `ticfac triage <epic>`, whose --run-id default resolves to the local id epic-<epic>: a store a cloud run never writes. A person following the named command finds "run epic-<epic> has no findings drafted for triage" and must discover --run-id on their own, while the hold the command was meant to clear stands. TriageCommandForRun already exists and is what this tick wired for prior runs' drafts; the current-run sites are the remaining half of the same seam.
evidence: internal/statusmodel/commands.go:35 (TriageCommand) used at internal/statusmodel/build.go:805 and :1007; internal/reconcile/findings.go:370 (triagePointer in the close-out hold); the wrong default resolves at internal/cli/findings.go:121 runID = runIDOfEpic(epicID)

ticfac run run_5c7c16d199414da2a8a40d97b524e987 created this tick by absorbing the finding b30da19b9556f901861dc6a5918c566a0151b1dfcabc23b588e9d3bda330780b (reported by run-run_5c7c16d199414da2a8a40d97b524e987/tick-d23/attempt-11): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A2. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/run_5c7c16d199414da2a8a40d97b524e987/absorptions/b30da19b9556f901861dc6a5918c566a0151b1dfcabc23b588e9d3bda330780b.json on the run branch.
